item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-0f850bb98b5c30a7","start_unit":11,"end_unit":11,"fact_summary":"Brazil's official defense description states that national nuclear technology is used exclusively for peaceful applications, that nuclear-submarine propulsion is permitted under the IAEA agreement, and that all submarine armaments will be conventional under Brazil's constitutional peaceful-use commitment.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.2","1B.4","1B.5","1B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The page was updated in 2024 and describes an ongoing national program; it does not identify a Lula-specific 2023 decision.","ruler_attribution":"Institutional policy and constitutional framework administered during Lula's 2023 term; direct presidential attribution is not established.","limitations":["Official ministry description; no independent verification of implementation or operational safeguards."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c481b76396e7952c","start_unit":13,"end_unit":13,"fact_summary":"The MDS states that the PPA 2024–2027 defines federal priorities, commitments, directions, objectives, and targets; it guides the LDO and LOA, and MDS programs are subject to monitoring, evaluation, and periodic review.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","5B.7","6B.1","6B.5","6B.9","8B.1","8B.2","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The PPA was adopted for 2024–2027, following Lula's first year in the period; it is evidence of a 2023-launched planning framework but not of 2023 outcomes.","ruler_attribution":"The document attributes the framework to the federal government and MDS; Lula's personal role is implied by presidential administration but not specifically described.","limitations":["The page does not report executed budgets, completed outputs, or measured outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c481b76396e7952c","start_unit":13,"end_unit":13,"fact_summary":"The PPA 2024–2027 establishes five transversal agendas giving integrated attention to children and adolescents, women, racial equality, Indigenous peoples, and the environment.","question_ids":["5B.8","6B.3","6B.8","8B.1","8B.2"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Framework adopted after 2023; relevant as a forward policy commitment emerging from the period.","ruler_attribution":"Federal government policy framework during Lula's administration; no specific presidential act beyond the government's PPA is identified.","limitations":["No evidence here of funding adequacy, territorial implementation, or incidence."]},{"source_id":"SRC-439f68ebdba5750b","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"UNICEF reports that in 2023 approximately 28.8 million Brazilian children lived in multidimensional poverty, including deprivations involving sanitation, income, housing, education, water, information, and child labor.","question_ids":["5B.8","6B.2","6B.3","6B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly covers 2023.","ruler_attribution":"National outcome during Lula's 2023 term; the source does not attribute the conditions specifically to Lula or quantify his causal contribution.","limitations":["The page does not provide a Lula-policy counterfactual or year-on-year attribution."]},{"source_id":"SRC-439f68ebdba5750b","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"UNICEF finds that Brazil's protection system, including Bolsa Família and SUAS, still had gaps in coverage and adequacy of crucial services, and that the COVID-19 pandemic and subsequent emergencies exposed weaknesses in adaptive capacity.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.5","6B.6","6B.9","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Describes conditions relevant to 2023, though the page does not date each assessment precisely.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns Brazil's institutional system during Lula's administration but does not assign personal responsibility.","limitations":["No specific 2023 reform, budget, or corrective action is documented in the cited units."]},{"source_id":"SRC-df6989d3165ddb4f","start_unit":11,"end_unit":11,"fact_summary":"On 22 June 2023, Brazil's defense minister met France's defense minister at the Paris Air Show to discuss defense partnerships and the PROSUB submarine program, which includes technology transfer and construction of four conventional submarines plus Brazil's first nuclear-propelled submarine.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.4","1B.10","5B.1","5B.6","8B.2","8B.3","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly covers 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The meeting was conducted by Lula's defense minister; Lula's personal direction is not stated.","limitations":["The source reports planned program components and projected employment, not completed 2023 outcomes or safeguards."]},{"source_id":"SRC-983d27970012f6a1","start_unit":11,"end_unit":12,"fact_summary":"On 27 December 2023, President Lula signed Decree 11.856/2023 establishing the National Cybersecurity Policy, with objectives including stronger cybersecurity governance, diligent action in cyberspace, and combating cybercrime and malicious activity.","question_ids":["1B.9","8B.1","8B.2","8B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly covers 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The source explicitly attributes the decree to President Lula.","limitations":["The cited text does not establish funding, enforcement results, or independent review."]},{"source_id":"SRC-983d27970012f6a1","start_unit":12,"end_unit":12,"fact_summary":"The cybersecurity decree created the National Cybersecurity Committee, composed of government, civil society, scientific, and business representatives, meeting quarterly; it can propose policy updates and international technical cooperation, with the GSI as executive secretariat.","question_ids":["1B.7","1B.9","8B.2","8B.4","8B.5","8B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly covers 2023 institutional design.","ruler_attribution":"The committee was created by Lula's signed decree.","limitations":["No evidence in the source of appointments, meetings, resources, or results during 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-e1bbcfb28d9857dd","start_unit":12,"end_unit":13,"fact_summary":"A 2021 survey of 237 Brazilian journalists reported that 93% of women journalists viewed disinformation as very serious, 55% saw daily effects on their routines, 8 in 10 changed social-media behavior for safety, and politicians including the president accounted for 8% of reported online-aggression cases; RSF characterized the pattern as institutionalization of violence against journalists.","question_ids":["3B.3","3B.8","4B.3","4B.6","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Evidence predates 2023; it describes an inherited media-safety environment relevant to Lula's starting conditions.","ruler_attribution":"The survey does not attribute the reported attacks to Lula; it identifies political actors generally and discusses the preceding Bolsonaro government.","limitations":["Survey fieldwork occurred in 2021 and cannot establish Lula-era change."]},{"source_id":"SRC-9d9ea8721a2992d8","start_unit":11,"end_unit":11,"fact_summary":"In a February 2023 UN Security Council statement, Brazil encouraged the EU to pursue a negotiated solution to the Ukraine conflict, warned that violence should not become normalized, and cautioned that unilateral sanctions often harm civilian populations and third countries.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.3","2B.7","2B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly covers February 2023 diplomatic policy.","ruler_attribution":"The statement was delivered by Brazil's permanent representative as an official position of Lula's government; Lula is not personally quoted.","limitations":["It records diplomatic advocacy, not a concluded settlement or measurable effect."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c8eab2a1f794e6e3","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"In February and March 2023, the CGU ordered or partially ordered disclosure of information concerning presidential helmet exemptions, prior presidential corporate-card expenditures and invoices, and First Lady-related expenditures, subject to legally required redactions or existing transparency exceptions.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.6","7B.2","7B.6","7B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly covers CGU decisions in 2023, concerning records from earlier periods.","ruler_attribution":"The findings concern the Presidency under Lula's administration, but the decisions were made by the independent CGU appeals process and do not establish Lula's personal conduct.","limitations":["Several requests concerned prior administrations or legally protected personal information; the document does not show Lula's response to each decision."]},{"source_id":"SRC-f32b74338a31ab73","start_unit":12,"end_unit":13,"fact_summary":"The MTE's PPA 2024–2027 assigns two final programs: promoting decent work, employment and income, and strengthening sustainable solidarity economy initiatives; the first also contributes to combating hunger and reducing inequalities.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.4","5B.8","6B.1","6B.3","8B.1","8B.2"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Framework adopted after 2023 and reflects policy priorities carried forward from Lula's first year.","ruler_attribution":"The programs are official federal policy under Lula's administration; no individual presidential decision is specified.","limitations":["The cited units provide objectives but no 2023 execution or outcome data."]},{"source_id":"SRC-f392bb6292d8ead5","start_unit":14,"end_unit":15,"fact_summary":"After the 8 January 2023 attack on Brazil's democratic institutions, Lula announced federal intervention in Federal District security until 31 January; by 9 January police had arrested about 1,500 people, while a Supreme Court justice temporarily removed the district governor for security failures.","question_ids":["3B.9","4B.1","4B.2","4B.4","4B.8","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly covers the January 2023 crisis.","ruler_attribution":"The federal intervention and announcement are explicitly attributed to President Lula; the judicial removal was attributed to the Supreme Court.","limitations":["The source is an external rights organization's account and does not assess proportionality, later prosecutions, or final accountability outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-f392bb6292d8ead5","start_unit":15,"end_unit":16,"fact_summary":"Human Rights Watch urged Lula's administration in January 2023 to strengthen judicial independence, transparency, free speech, social rights, environmental enforcement, protection of defenders, gender-violence services, police accountability, and anti-corruption safeguards, indicating substantial inherited institutional and human-rights challenges.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.7","3B.8","4B.3","4B.4","4B.6","6B.3","7B.6","7B.10"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Directly concerns the beginning of Lula's 2023 term and inherited conditions.","ruler_attribution":"The recommendations are addressed to Lula's administration, but describe problems largely worsened during the prior Bolsonaro presidency.","limitations":["Recommendations are not evidence that Lula implemented or failed to implement each requested measure during 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4b186792c31b45bc","start_unit":12,"end_unit":13,"fact_summary":"The Ministry of Justice created the Observatory for Violence against Journalists and Social Communicators through Ordinance 306 dated 16 February 2023, to monitor and combat violence against journalists and strengthen press-freedom protections.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.8","3B.9","4B.3","4B.6","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly covers a February 2023 institutional action.","ruler_attribution":"The observatory was created by Lula's federal justice ministry; the president's personal involvement is not stated.","limitations":["The source does not report staffing, budget, investigations, enforcement, or measurable results."]},{"source_id":"SRC-e9b1fc84974a84b7","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"In a 2024 UN speech, Lula stated that in 2023 Brazil removed 24.4 million people from severe food insecurity and presented creation of a Global Alliance Against Hunger and Poverty as a government commitment.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.9","5B.10","6B.1","6B.2","6B.3","6B.10","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The quantitative claim concerns 2023, but the source is a retrospective 2024 speech.","ruler_attribution":"The result and commitment are explicitly presented by Lula as achievements and priorities of his government.","limitations":["Retrospective presidential claim; the supplied unit does not provide methodology, independent validation, or distributional detail."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":[],"batch_limitations":["The supplied corpus contains nine documents. Several are institutional webpages or retrospective sources whose evidence supports policy frameworks or context but not completed 2023 implementation outcomes.","No scores were assigned."]}
